_comment: POPULATED REFERENCE manifest showing the tools AI4IA can place in a toolbox via azure-ai-projects. This is an EXAMPLE only (the canonical live toolbox is foundry/toolbox.manifest.json). To use it, copy this over toolbox.manifest.json (or pass --manifest foundry/toolbox.manifest.example.json), prune the tools you do not want, create the referenced connections, then run scripts/provision-foundry-toolbox.py. Every tool listed here is consumed through the official-MCP APIM front door once the toolbox is registered in infra/mcp-servers.json. Note: computer_use and bing_custom_search are agent-level tools with no toolbox equivalent in the SDK, so they are not toolbox tools. The service allows at most one unnamed tool total, so every tool here has a `name` (or `serverLabel` for the `mcp` tool). All tools are Azure public preview.
name: ai4ia-toolbox
description: AI4IA shared Foundry toolbox (populated reference). Groups grounding, code execution, browsing, and tool search behind one APIM-fronted MCP endpoint.

tools.name: ai4ia-rag
tools.description: RAG over the AI4IA AI Search index. Requires the 'ai4ia-search' project connection. Shape is azureAiSearch.indexes[] (SDK 2.3.0's AzureAISearchToolResource), not root-level indexName/projectConnectionId.

tools.name: code-interpreter
tools.description: Foundry-managed sandboxed Python (distinct from AI4IA's existing direct Responses-API code interpreter).

tools.name: custom-code-interpreter
tools.description: Custom code interpreter: runs a BYO container image in the Foundry sandbox.

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Drive a hosted browser via a connected Playwright Workspace (preview; heavier isolation review recommended). Requires the 'ai4ia-browser-automation' project connection (a Playwright Workspace connection, not a plain API connection). Shape is browserAutomationPreview.connection.projectConnectionId (SDK 2.3.0's BrowserAutomationToolParameters), which is nested one level deeper than the toolbox-search example above.

tools.name: file-search
tools.description: Search files attached to the toolbox via a vector store. Connectionless once files are attached.

tools.name: openapi-example
tools.description: Call an OpenAPI-described REST API as a tool. Replace the placeholder spec with a real one.

openapi.name: get_weather
openapi.description: Look up the current weather for a city.

tools.description: Nest an upstream MCP server as a tool (identified by serverLabel, not name). Requires the 'ai4ia-mcp-upstream' project connection for auth.

tools.name: tool-search
tools.description: Tool search: lets the model pick from a large tool set. Add so the toolbox self-describes its tools.
